daily_pass.name: Paris Visite
daily_pass.coverage: Metro, RER, Bus within Paris zones 1-3

tips: Buy a Navigo Easy card for pay-as-you-go metro rides
Avoid taxis from CDG — 3x more expensive than RER B
Metro runs until 1am on weekdays, 2am on weekends
Vélib' bike-share great for short trips between attractions

daily_pass.name: Suica Card (IC card)
daily_pass.coverage: JR lines, Tokyo Metro, most buses

tips: JR Pass worth it if doing 2+ day trips (Nikko, Kamakura, Kyoto)
Suica/Pasmo IC cards accepted at convenience stores too
Avoid taxis — expensive and often stuck in traffic
24-hour Tokyo Metro pass ($6) great for metro-heavy days

daily_pass.name: OMNY 7-day Unlimited
daily_pass.coverage: All NYC subway lines and local buses

tips: Subway runs 24/7 — most reliable city option
Tap OMNY with contactless card or phone at turnstiles
Avoid taxis/rideshare from JFK during peak hours
CitiBike (bike-share) good for Brooklyn Bridge and waterfront
